Maison.title: Maison Soleil: from platform dependence to owning the booking path
Maison.lead: Andrew Gee has run Maison Soleil in the Seychelles since 2009 — a boutique retreat with real soul, art, and an exceptional location. The business was strong. The digital system was not.
story: For years, the property relied on an outdated website and third-party platforms that took commission, sat in the middle of the guest relationship, and left Andrew with less control over how guests arrived — and stayed.

We rebuilt the full foundation: a site worthy of the place, a clear direct inquiry and booking path, and automation so interest does not go cold. The goal was never “a new website.” It was for Maison Soleil to attract, convert, and own the guest relationship on its own terms.

Today the property runs on its own domain with a direct booking narrative, WhatsApp to the owner, and a brand experience that matches the retreat — instead of renting distribution and hoping the platforms stay friendly.
Maison.shift: From renting distribution to owning the path from discovery → conversation → booking.
